headline: Olatunji Disu Elected As President Of The Nigeria Judo Federation
seoTitle: Olatunji Disu Elected President of Nigeria Judo Federation
metaDescription: Olatunji Disu has been unanimously elected president of the Nigeria Judo Federation, following a vote held at a national congress in Abuja.
aiSummaryBullets: Olatunji Disu was elected president of the Nigeria Judo Federation during a national elective congress held in Abuja.
The election process concluded with Disu receiving all 13 votes from the delegates present at the event.
Following his election, the new president oversaw the opening of an inter-club judo championship in Lagos involving 20 participating teams.
aiContextParagraph: The Nigeria Judo Federation held its National Elective Congress in Abuja, where Olatunji Disu was selected to lead the organization. Disu received unanimous support from the 13 voters participating in the electoral process. Following the confirmation of his presidency, Disu traveled to Lagos to officially inaugurate an inter-club championship. This sporting event features competition among 20 teams from across the region. The election and the subsequent tournament launch mark a transition in the federation's leadership and the continuation of its national schedule of athletic activities. The proceedings in Abuja and the opening of the tournament in Lagos represent the latest developments for the sport in Nigeria as the organization shifts into its new administrative term.
whyItIsViral: The event is being tracked due to reports from two independent national media outlets documenting the leadership change.
